description: A personal, drag-and-drop ordered list of what each user wants to watch next
name: Watch Next
overview: A personal, drag-and-drop ordered list of what each user wants to watch next

versions.changelog:
### Fixed

- **The menu entry now appears on desktop and TV, not just on phones.** Jellyfin's modern web client only renders its navigation drawer on narrow viewports; on a desktop the drawer is not in the page at all and the user views sit in the top bar instead, so the entry had nowhere to appear. The TV layout is different again — it runs Jellyfin's legacy app, with its own drawer. All three are handled now.
- Links to an item's detail page pick their routing style from the current URL, which is correct in both the modern and the legacy app.
- Opening an item from the list no longer leaves a stale history entry behind, so going back from a detail page lands where you opened the list from.

### Added

- **Things you have already watched can no longer be added.** A movie once it is played, a show as soon as you have watched any one of its episodes — the same rule that already takes entries off the list. Search leaves them out, and the add is refused with a reason if it is tried anyway.
- Search also leaves out whatever is already on one of your lists.

Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer and the [File Transformation](https://github.com/IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-file-transformation) plugin.

First release.

Every user gets their own **Watch Next** entry in the navigation drawer — no admin dashboard access needed — holding two separately ordered lists, one for movies and one for shows.

- Drag to reorder, with a mouse or a finger. Reordering uses pointer events rather than HTML5 drag-and-drop, which never fires on touch screens, and auto-scrolls when you drag past the edge of the screen.
- Entries remove themselves once watched: a movie when playback finishes or when it is ticked off by hand, a show as soon as **any** of its episodes is watched. Un-watching never puts anything back.
- Each row shows the poster (falling back to the thumbnail) and a title that links to the item's detail page.
- The two lists sit side by side on a desktop and stack into one column on a phone.
- Lists are private per user and are stored outside the plugin's version-stamped folder, so updating the plugin does not wipe them.

**Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer**, and the [File Transformation](https://github.com/IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-file-transformation) plugin, which is what lets this plugin add its drawer entry. Jellyfin's catalogue has no concept of dependencies, so install that one first from `https://www.iamparadox.dev/jellyfin/plugins/manifest.json`.
